paragraphs.text: Automated AI agents are actively harvesting API keys from exposed AI applications, while compromised third-party credentials have enabled supply chain attacks on code-signing infrastructure and development tool marketplaces, expanding the blast radius of credential theft beyond traditional boundaries.

CISA's addition of an actively exploited UnrealIRCd flaw to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog and Italy's €805 million GDPR fine against Meta for non-consensual data access signal heightened regulatory expectations for vulnerability remediation and default data protection controls.
